headline: Market closed for weekend; on last trading day, Sensex slipped 289 points amid inflation concerns.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on sentiment during the last trading session.
Strong dollar and demand concerns reduced momentum in base metals.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices provided underlying support earlier in the week.
Sectoral buying in PSU banks helped indices extend gains over the full week.
whatHappening: In the last session on Friday, Sensex dropped 289 points as Nifty experienced downside pressure.
Despite Friday's drop, Indian benchmarks NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their weekly rally for a 3rd straight week.
USFDA concluded an inspection at Zydus' LiqMeds facility in the UK with 4 observations.
Noel Tata highlighted that a potential Tata Sons listing will engage with regulators and transform group operations.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November. In the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns dented investor sentiment. However, broader benchmarks managed to extend gains for the third consecutive week led by PSU banks.
